whatThisReviewIsAndIsNot: The four pages were rasterised from the finished artifact bytes and looked at as images by the same agent that ran the build. That makes it independent of the RENDER REPORT and of the field map -- it can see a value clipped by its widget, a value on the wrong printed line, a caption overwritten, or a blank that should be empty carrying ink, none of which a report can tell you about itself. It is NOT an independent reviewer in the sense the production holds require, because the reader and the writer are the same agent. f_independent_visual_review_required is NOT discharged by this file.
verdict: No page shows a participant value in a blank that does not belong to it, no clipped or overrunning value, and no signature, verification, notarial jurat, certificate-of-service or court-only rule carrying ink. The whole of page 2 is blank in both fixtures.
stillRequired: Output-level legal approval; this build only requests it.
